title: Unit 32 Consolidation: The Constitution and Fundamental Rights
goal: I can use the words of constitutional review, fundamental rights and judicial reasoning.
I can use stance adverbials, participles before a noun, cause and the past conditional.
I can explain *anyajog* and *láthatatlan alkotmány* as Sólyom László's terms.
